answer_1.quote: We present COCOON(Active-Listening-Based Proactive Emotional Support Conversation Corpus), a dataset constructed using GPT-4o to facilitate proactive emotional support in dialogue systems... We train COCOON-Llama3, a proactive emotional support model.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of the conversation using the following seven key indicators and provide a score (1-10): Fluency, Diversity, Empathy, Information, Humanoid, Skillful... We also report Success Rate (SR) and psychological‑scale based metrics.

answer_3.quote: To evaluate the quality of the conversation we employ GPT-4o with prompts that ask it to score Fluency, Diversity, Empathy, Information, Humanoid, Skillful... We also use GPT-4o to answer Comfort Scale and RAC metric questionnaires.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a small‑scale human evaluation on the dialogue results... Human evaluations are carried out by two psychology experts to ensure domain‑relevant and reliable judgments.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assess the dialogues on criteria such as fluency, diversity, informativeness, skillfulness, and also on psychological‑scale items (e.g., affective improvement, negative helper evaluations).
